name: Hananiah
overview: Hananiah appears in Scripture as a name borne by several individuals who served in various important roles within the community of Israel. Among these, Hananiah is noted as a faithful ruler of the palace in Jerusalem, entrusted with leadership and revered for his fear of God (Nehemiah 7:2). Others named Hananiah contributed to the rebuilding and fortification of Jerusalem, such as the son of an apothecary who worked alongside goldsmiths to strengthen the city's defenses (Nehemiah 3:8), and another who repaired sections of the wall (Nehemiah 3:30). Additionally, Hananiah is mentioned as a priest during the days of Jehoiakim, indicating a role of spiritual leadership (Nehemiah 12:12). These references collectively highlight Hananiah as a name associated with faithful service, leadership, and priestly duties in the post-exilic community.
